workers.title: Fix: offline edits lost on reconnect

turns.text: [bb message from thread:thr_synwork0001] Found it: the resolver compares device clocks, and the reconnecting device's clock was behind, so its edits lost every conflict. Fix: use the server's sequence numbers. Branch fix-sync-seq, tests green.
turns.reply:
The sync fix is ready on fix-sync-seq: the resolver now trusts the server's sequence numbers instead of device clocks. Want me to merge it?
